title: gyro phase two orientation estimation

commit.merge_subject: merge: gyro phase two orientation estimation

description:
offline orientation estimation for stabilization phase 2, on gyro
timestamps: quaternion series a later warp can sample per frame.

what:
- integrateGyro: gyro-only integration baseline. identity at the first
  gyro timestamp, one exponential-map step per sample using the actual
  inter-sample dt (backward hold: sample i covers the interval ending
  at t_i). no bias correction, no accel — the analytic reference the
  vqf result is validated against.
- estimateOrientationVqf: vendored vqf (932a9c4) fed the canonical
  gyro (rad/s) and accel (m/s^2) streams. accel is resampled onto the
  gyro grid first so both run at the mean gyro interval (the fixed-
  rate approximation is documented in the header). tauAcc = 40 s
  follows the gyroflow precedent for video stabilization — trust the
  gyro, correct drift slowly. the filter state is recorded BEFORE each
  sample's update so every recorded
changed: feat: axis remap into canonical camera frame
feat: orientation estimation on canonical imu
